description: Normative host kinds, operations, query limits and activation exchange, read with the pinned specification, description contract and schemas. A reference shape conveys no authority. The host checks scope, profiles, contracts and dependencies. Validators assert formats, including calendar validity for date-time. The versioned conformance tool provides evidence separately.

renderer_history.missing: A portable renderer request and reply for browsing authorized revisions and picking one from history.
renderer_history.blocks: Browse Notes history and select a revision from the listing. Restoring an already-held checked revision remains available under host.item.restore.
renderer_history.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

linked_user_comments.missing: A portable checked comment submission and returned comment record for linked users.
linked_user_comments.blocks: Linked-user Comment, including durable creation, delivery and revocation.
linked_user_comments.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

historical_transcript_attribution.missing: Committed-record fields for historical headings and author, time, machine and login attribution.
historical_transcript_attribution.blocks: Equal rendering and attribution after history restore, projection rebuild and rollback.
historical_transcript_attribution.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

attachment_upload.missing: A portable, checked composer upload contract that produces a Draft AttachmentRef.
attachment_upload.blocks: Submit a draft with a new attachment on an eligible machine.
attachment_upload.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.
attachment_upload.proposal: Sealed generic-engines §§A.1, C.3 use checked composer material and leave acquisition outside this revision. §B.4 defers the new general file-upload routes.

mention_lookup.missing: A portable, scoped lookup and selection contract for composer mentions.
mention_lookup.blocks: Choose an authorized recipient and submit that mention under prepared Send.
mention_lookup.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.
mention_lookup.proposal: Sealed generic-engines §§A.1, C.3 define checked mentions in prepared material and leave lookup transport outside this revision.

queued_follow_up.missing: Portable requests and record state for queuing, viewing, editing, cancelling and submitting follow-ups.
queued_follow_up.blocks: Queue and manage a follow-up independently of direct Send or steer.
queued_follow_up.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

snooze_presets.missing: The host policy and portable presentation for the offered snooze presets.
snooze_presets.blocks: Pass the shipped preset snooze workflow using the actor-scoped writer.
snooze_presets.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

snooze_custom_picker.missing: The custom snooze picker policy, including supported date/time choices, time zone and defaults.
snooze_custom_picker.blocks: Pass the shipped custom date/time snooze workflow using the actor-scoped writer.
snooze_custom_picker.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

collection_creation.missing: A portable renderer action for creating a host-owned collection, including in the bulk workflow.
collection_creation.blocks: Create a collection from Notes or as part of placing bulk-selected items.
collection_creation.cutover: Disabled until a later numbered revision pins this requirement.

audiences.member_item: Live item authority and field policy on the member path.
audiences.shared_projection: Member authority or a host-approved explicit projection for a guest or public link, within its checked grant. Counts require a separate projection flag.
audiences.viewer_self: The actor may access only their own projected value. AccountRef predicates are limited to eq viewer.person; only counts over that actor’s already authorized projection are allowed. Other typed personal fields use the actor’s index only.
audiences.designated_request_actor: Host-private request addressed to the designated viewer. Covers only the referenced eligible request. No guest list or count. A row id resolves only to a checked RequestRef.
audiences.eligible_execution_actor: The current execution starter or a viewer with live PluginsManage and item authority. An item grant alone confers no execution control.
audiences.personal_layout: Only a live space member may read or mutate their own layout for this space and app. Check membership and actor on every read and write. Layout membership grants no item access.

eligible_execution_actor.description: Requires live eligibility in either member audience.

layout_sections.description: Section repeater source for the live member’s own layout scoped to space and app. Section.repeat.over must read layout_sections. In repeated item windows the host binds a placement reference and an underlying item reference separately in the action context.

provider_marks.trust: A provider-specific mark name belongs to the verified publisher identified by a trusted signed gallery entry or an explicit operator checksum pin. The signed entry or operator pin binds the approved package artifact and publisher identity to the canonical mark names it owns. A checksum without an explicit publisher and mark binding does not establish mark ownership.
provider_marks.install: Verify the installed artifact and its publisher using the existing gallery signature or operator checksum pin. Record the canonical mark name, verified publisher, installed package identity, provider contribution ID, pinned manifest digest and trusted ownership source. Record a usable distinctive mark only if the verified publisher owns that name. Do not grant an unowned mark based on installation order. Calternal providers use the same rules.
provider_marks.projection: Emit provider_icon only when the active installed contribution matches the recorded binding and its verified publisher still owns the mark. Omit it on missing trust, missing ownership or any conflict, including on a fresh or offline host without verified ownership data. Recheck on installation updates, uninstalls and trust changes. The row draws its generic fallback symbol when the field is omitted. The field name is host-owned across all kinds. Distinctive names resolve only through this trust rule, including when a template claims a symbol by name. A field-backed symbol cannot take a body-derived source.

host.item.create.authority: Live content creation authority in the current space and the owning installed kind’s host_create declaration. For optional collection placement check live authority to edit membership in that collection in the same space under the commit fence.

kind.description: The host resolves this from the template’s declared literal kind and checks its owning manifest.

collection.description: Optional. Take only a server-resolved route operand or a template literal. Omit when the named route parameter is absent. Apply the opaque collection refusal to any supplied ref that is absent, foreign, unreadable or not editable.

host.item.create.confirmation_when: No challenge, including for a shared collection. The checked operation creates a new empty item and exposes no existing material.

collection_unavailable.rule: Use the same outer status and ActionOutcome code and message for a supplied ref that is absent, foreign, unreadable or not editable. Look up the ref only in the current space and return no collection-specific fields. At resolve and dispatch check this access before any quota or dependency result that could reveal the collection. For an otherwise authentic host.item.create activation whose collection was deleted or lost edit access after resolve, the opaque collection_unavailable outcome takes precedence over the generic stale dependency outcome.

create_limit_reached.message: This item could not be created because a limit was reached.
create_limit_reached.rule: Check the normal item and collection membership quotas under the commit fence. Refuse the whole transaction when either would be exceeded.

host.item.create.atomic_undo_when: Reject manifest defaults for extractor outputs and device image slots. Run the installed host extractors, including body_excerpt, on the empty source and validate the initial state with the allowed defaults. Under the same fence check authority and the normal item and membership quotas, then commit the empty item, its optional collection membership and Undo in one FULL content transaction. Record the item head, item-wide membership and sharing revisions and revision of the introduced membership, if any. Undo checks live authority and all these revisions under the fence and refuses if any changed. On success it removes the item and the membership introduced by this create together. Return the created ref only after commit. Optional declared package follow-up runs separately after commit and cannot delay this no-wake operation.

host.item.rename.atomic_undo_when: Single-item rename in the FULL content transaction with its Undo and no deferred inbound-link rewrites.

input_schema.$comment: The host supplies Undo when the committed lifecycle result is eligible.

host.item.trash.atomic_undo_when: Single item whose complete lifecycle change is in the FULL content transaction (including replayable placement and Undo). Excludes lifecycle cleanup in another engine.
host.item.trash.full_swipe_when: First swipe action, effective confirm:none and this operation’s atomic_undo_when condition.

input_schema.$comment: Source revision selects history restore. Absent selects a current Trash head. Host pins expected revision from the activation context.

host.item.restore.atomic_undo_when: Single-item Trash restore or history restore in the FULL content transaction with its Undo.
host.item.restore.full_swipe_when: First swipe action restoring one item from Trash, effective confirm:none and this operation’s atomic_undo_when condition.

host.undo.authority: Original authorized actor or permitted current editor with a live eligible reference

host.trash.purge.authority: Manager or Owner, with confirmation of the pinned selection and authority at every batch

host.panel.ask.authority: Person authorized to use the panel and its item/draft; guest Prompt disabled

host.execution.stop.authority: Reconstruct the exact target and apply execution_intents.stop_and_archive and attempt_authority_end.actions.stop.

host.route.set.authority: Viewer with live access to the target route

host.item.share.authority: Actor allowed to manage sharing for the exact selected items

host.item.patch-metadata.authority: Editor with current room-backed head and package-approved metadata field
host.item.patch-metadata.full_swipe_when: Host-validated single-item boolean toggle, confirm:none and atomic Undo. Expected revision comes from the activation context.
host.item.patch-metadata.atomic_undo_when: A checked single boolean toggle with its Undo in the room-checked FULL content transaction.

host.action.status.engine: protected action / rename / Trash job status
host.action.status.authority: Live authorized audience of the originating host outcome

host.item.archive.authority: Actor with live item lifecycle authority
host.item.archive.atomic_undo_unavailable: The current writer commits the archived head without Undo, then enters a separate protected authority transaction. Keep both flags false and the challenge in place until the Step 2 idle-archive writer gate passes.
host.item.archive.confirmation_when: Before the writer gate passes, require a challenge. After it passes, an eligible idle archive resolves and dispatches in one exchange without a sheet. Challenge archive outside atomic_undo_when. Retiring grants with head-only Undo requires a challenge. For an active execution the host-written material says: The running execution will be stopped. Any unresolved execution intent or active attempt requires confirmation bound to that exact target and the current starter or live PluginsManage authority.
host.item.archive.atomic_undo_when: Use the execution_intents idle predicate under the lifecycle fence. Saved authority requires a challenge unless it consists only of item grants that the Step 2 writer retires in the same FULL item content transaction as archive and that Undo restores together with the item head. Retiring grants with head-only Undo requires a challenge. Check idle eligibility under the commit fence. Execution admission rejects a fresh admission to an archived head under the same fence. Commit the archived head and its unarchive Undo in one FULL item content transaction, with no separate cleanup.
host.item.archive.full_swipe_when: After the Step 2 idle-archive atomic writer with Undo passes, enable atomic_undo and full_swipe for the first swipe action with effective confirm:none and the idle condition.
host.item.archive.execution_fence: Apply attempt_authority_end.actions.archive in the FULL archive transaction and preserve that fence across Undo.

host.item.unarchive.authority: Actor with live item lifecycle authority
host.item.unarchive.atomic_undo_when: Single-item unarchive in the FULL content transaction with its Undo. Undo refuses if the item revision or lifecycle dependencies changed.
host.item.unarchive.full_swipe_when: First swipe action, effective confirm:none and this operation’s atomic_undo_when condition.

host.item.snooze.authority: Member changing their own item snooze
host.item.snooze.atomic_undo_unavailable: The current item writer stores one shared manual deadline and cannot implement this actor-scoped operation. Set available to true only after the Step 2 actor-keyed snooze writer gate proves that the actor’s deadline, its durable publication intent and Undo commit together and the index catches up under query.list_publication. The host refuses snooze on every route while available is false. Subscription retry state is unaffected. Apply execution_intents.snooze to all execution intents. See attempt_authority_end.actions.snooze.

host.collection.move.authority: Live write authority on selected items and both named collections
host.collection.move.atomic_undo_when: The destination’s effective audience contains only the actor and the FULL content transaction commits the complete move and its Undo. A move across two collections is ineligible until both membership changes commit together.
host.collection.move.confirmation_when: Require a challenge only if the destination collection’s effective audience contains anyone other than the actor. Recheck under the commit fence. If the destination becomes shared, require a fresh challenge before dispatch.

host.layout.move_to.engine: personal layout placement with complete effect and Undo committed together
host.layout.move_to.authority: Live space membership and the actor’s own space/app layout, with context-pinned layout revision and live item and parent access for placements.

conversation.description: Adds the underlying thread if it has no placement in this layout. Refuse if a placement already exists.

entry.description: Moves the existing placement. Check its underlying item authority.

input_schema.description: The destination comes from the scoped ChoiceRef and requires a protected preview. Host reconstructs the thread or entry from the checked action context.

host.layout.move_up.engine: personal layout order with complete effect and Undo committed together
host.layout.move_up.authority: Live space membership and the actor’s own space/app layout, with context-pinned layout revision and live item and parent access for placements.

host.layout.move_down.engine: personal layout order with complete effect and Undo committed together
host.layout.move_down.authority: Live space membership and the actor’s own space/app layout, with context-pinned layout revision and live item and parent access for placements.

host.layout.section.create.authority: Live space membership and the actor’s own space/app layout, with context-pinned layout revision and live item and parent access for placements.
host.layout.section.create.atomic_undo_when: Commit the new section and Undo that removes it in one per-person layout revision transaction.

host.layout.section.rename.authority: Live space membership and the actor’s own space/app layout, with context-pinned layout revision and live item and parent access for placements.
host.layout.section.rename.atomic_undo_when: Commit the new title and Undo carrying the prior title in one per-person layout revision transaction.

host.layout.section.remove.engine: personal layout remove section without changing item content or access
host.layout.section.remove.authority: Live space membership and the actor’s own space/app layout, with context-pinned layout revision and live item and parent access for placements.
host.layout.section.remove.atomic_undo_when: One per-person layout revision transaction retires the section and its placement generation and commits Undo for that generation. Until Undo expires, retain the generation and exclude it from reads. Undo rechecks live membership and the post-effect layout revision and reactivates the exact generation atomically. Reactivation grants no item access. Reclaim expired retired generations in bounded background batches. Removal and Undo perform no per-placement work.

host.execution.resume.engine: admit a fresh continuation intent under the conversation lifecycle fence
host.execution.resume.authority: Host composer only. Issue an action only to a live member with edit, corpus and execution-start authority who owns the protected binding or its retirement marker. A marker yields only the unavailable refusal. Admission checks authenticated historical account, exact provider contribution, conversation, enrolled machine and original profile, with a qualified provider sandbox and proven original login profile and current placement and effects. Withhold the action from guests and non-owners. Refuse forged or revoked invocations opaquely.
host.execution.resume.confirmation_when: Always challenge. Show the checked conversation, provider, machine, profile and permissions. Pin the binding generation and lifecycle state. Resolve receives no interaction values, and ConfirmActivation carries no final_text. Confirm rechecks the proof and dispatches in that exchange.
host.execution.resume.rules: Use execution_intents.admission. Reconcile uncertain effects before committing a fresh continuation intent through the owning composer job. Append no message. Do not replay old messages, approvals or the previous execution. Exact authorized replay returns the same receipt. Do not disclose or let the client select session IDs.

previous_session_unavailable.message: Previous session unavailable. Start a new session.
previous_session_unavailable.rule: Return only to an authorized owner of the historical record, including the retired-binding marker, when the original binding is unavailable or unproved. Do not start a fresh session automatically.

execution_busy.message: An execution is already starting or running.
execution_busy.rule: Require an idle conversation under the lifecycle fence.

reconciliation_required.message: The previous execution still needs reconciliation.
reconciliation_required.rule: An uncertain effect must be reconciled before admitting a continuation.

stale_context.rule: Changed checked material or a stale proof requires a new resolve and challenge. A loss of authority returns opaque not-found.

operators.eq: Same scalar type or an explicitly nullable field compared to null.
operators.ne: Same scalar type; available only for a bounded indexed complement.
operators.in: One to 32 homogeneous scalars of the field type; no coercion or nested list.
operators.lt: Ordered indexed number, timestamp or approved collation key.
operators.exists: No operand. Tests indexed non-null presence; use equality with null on nullable fields for absence.
operators.prefix: Nonempty text normalized with the field's indexed collation; up to 128 UTF-8 bytes.

count_modes.exact: Count of the authorized projection at its checked result version. Guest requires explicit count permission. For non-search lists apply query.list_publication. For search apply query.search.count.
count_modes.estimate: Audience-certified member estimate only. A guest never gets an estimate. Refuse an end anchor with end_unavailable and never send an end-relative result.
count_modes.none: Omit count. This is always the guest fallback, including nested windows, unless the authorized projection allows an exact count. Refuse an end anchor with end_unavailable and never send an end-relative result.

window.description: The declared parent edge constrains the nested lookup and any count before filtering or pagination. Authorize the entire parent ancestry and each returned row. A parent operand is an optional extra predicate. A Bind may be a section rows Bind or a children target, never both. Section rows present LayoutEntryRef; child rows present their kind’s row ref. The window_ref identifies the Bind, stable parent, anchor and issued range within the current lease and partition. Separately cap materialized rows and entries skipped in an index-only jump over the scoped covering index from the nearer end. Absolute jumps are capped by max_offset. An explicit start anchor can cross that cap only for forward continuation without exact count authority, exactly at the next row of a host-issued ready start window for the current view, Bind, parent and result version. Seek from the checked boundary key. Before planning an end-relative request, check the effective authorized count mode for its Bind and scope. Require a non-search Bind and exact count authority. For search or with mode estimate or none return WindowPlanError with reason end_unavailable and no end distance. A view with count mode none shows no scroll extent implying a total. An index-only jump beyond the skip cap returns WindowPlanError with reason skip_limit. Non-search list plans use maintained scope counts under query.list_publication, including for an end anchor. Search counts use query.search.count. Check the live field and its source before using any sort or filter. A grant on the item or a generic display name cannot authorize an unreadable predicate or ordering key.

list_publication.commit: Commit the authoritative item or scope change and its durable publication intent and any receipt and Undo before acknowledgement. The save does not wait for index publication.
list_publication.replay: The host window engine replays committed intents shortly after save. Replay is bounded and idempotent. Publish the audience-scoped covering keys, row snapshots, count, and verified source epoch and watermark together. Bound work and retention and recover from a checkpoint or rebuild before declaring the projection current.
list_publication.authority: Check live scope, row and field authority at planning and delivery. Fence revocation and affected old results immediately. Deny scopes that lost authority. Hidden-only changes leave the visible state, rows, ordering, counts and result version unchanged.

catch_up.rule: When the visible projection is behind or cannot be verified, withhold rows, count, activation contexts, cache records, result version, window reference and end distance. Do not reuse superseded results or selections. For an otherwise eligible End request, correlate loading on the active request with anchor:end and omit offset and count.

list_publication.qualification: Before enabling the path, pass the Step 2 power-cut and backlog gate, including revocation races, bounded drain, exact recovery, no worker wakes and the foreground save gate.

text_set.rules: Budget all changed covering, membership and count keys across fields, items and scopes before committing the save, share, membership or Undo. Mandatory revoke fences first and defers excess cleanup. Publish covering and count keys under query.list_publication. Counts include each authorized item once. TextSet is not sortable. Measure TextSet replay against max_total_index_keys, including covering and count work.
text_set.contains: One nonempty Text element of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. A text literal or a checked route resolved as Text is eligible. AccountRef and parent refs are ineligible.

body_excerpt.description: A claimed-text kind may declare an indexed Text field with source body_excerpt. The host index produces the first plain text after the title, collapses whitespace and truncates at a UTF-8 character boundary within max_utf8_bytes. Expose it only to a viewer authorized for the body and the declared field. Writers cannot supply the derived value. Omit the field when normalization yields no text.

row_images.provenance: The host marks an image body-derived from trusted provenance, including a device snapshot of the body or a job output produced from it. A manifest flag alone cannot determine provenance. Without established provenance, withhold the image.
row_images.retention: Keep the last authorized asset marked stale across a head advance until replacement. Recheck current item, field, body and retained source revision at delivery. Purge, redaction and revoke fence delivery before cleanup. A stale mark means a retained older authorized image, which is still readable. It is not an expired reference.
row_images.authorization: Only the host may mint a ref in an authorized ready window. Bind it to the account, space, live view lease, row, retained source revision, field and exact asset. Use the view host origin, live session and lease to fetch it. Resolve through the host origin with authentication and recheck the binding and live item and image-field authority before sending bytes. For a body-derived image also recheck live body authority at fetch, even when the item and image-field grants remain valid. Return the same opaque 404 for absent, expired, unretained, oversized or unauthorized images. No redirects, worker wake or outbound fetch.
row_images.cache: Use Cache-Control: no-store on the HTTP reply. Keep decoded images only in renderer memory keyed by ref for a currently authorized row. Drop them on row or ref replacement, revocation, lease loss or account switch. Omit refs and images from persisted member rows and refine_query replies.
row_images.draw: Request the image asynchronously. While a navigation key repeats, defer new image reads and cancel reads in flight. Once the key settles, fetch only still-visible rows' current refs. While loading or unavailable, use the declared RowImageIcon fallback if present; otherwise leave the image slot blank.
row_images.publish: Check upload identity, exact source-state digest, revision and item/edit authority before admitting bytes and again before pointer commit. Strip image metadata and stamp the authenticated uploader as host provenance. Serve only the normalized delivery variant under the smaller read caps. First valid upload wins the slot and exact replay returns its receipt. Reserve bounded staging up front, make bytes durable before the pointer, and sweep expired grants, reservations and orphan bytes by the cleanup deadline, including on restart before admission.
row_images.attribution: On a ready authorized member row, include image_attribution only when the viewer may see the exact asset uploader's identity. Bind its host-authenticated account and display label to the delivered image field and retained asset. Omit for guest or public, identity loss, every cache record and every non-ready row. Image metadata is stripped.

query.cross_bind_operands: Forbidden in the first query slice. Action and component references to upstream fields still require one authorized projected row and a checked dependency edge.

scope_limit_refusal.description: Check projected scope fan-out before committing a grant or other scope-expanding change. Count distinct effective (collection, audience) scopes per item after resolving direct and inherited ACL paths. Refuse the whole change if any item would exceed the cap. The scalar-order path touches at most two covering keys per effective scope. Measure TextSet replay against query.text_set.max_total_index_keys.
scope_limit_refusal.message: An item can belong to at most 32 effective scopes.

claimed_text.eligibility: Any plugin kind with claimed_text and searchable both true in its installed manifest. Notes uses this same qualification.

tokenizer.name: unicode61
tokenizer.qualification: Compile each full-text literal and token prefix using the published generation’s own qualified FTS5 tokenizer. Apply the token and posting bounds to those tokens and that generation’s term statistics. A tokenizer change requires a rebuilt generation and matching term statistics. Accented Latin and Cyrillic qualify. Refuse Devanagari full text, including token prefixes, with unsupported_query_plan until a rebuilt generation with the mark-aware categories is ready. CJK qualifies only for a whole unspaced run or its leading prefix. Implicit word segmentation and interior substring matching are unsupported_query_plan.

claimed_text.match: For all, match authorized title and body together in the published scope-local FTS index. An AND query may match terms in different fields of the same item. Return each item once in the kind’s stable scope-local order.
claimed_text.additional_scopes: Per-parent and parent plus collection Binds require an independently qualified scope-local index. Space and manual-collection measurements do not qualify those scopes.

conversation.tokenizer: Titles use the existing claimed-text FTS5 tokenizer. Messages use the existing message_terms tokenizer, which splits at non-alphanumeric characters and lowercases Unicode.
conversation.qualification: For all, match the full query against an authorized title or within one authorized message. Emit distinct conversations with title matches first, in stable conversation ID order, followed by message-only matches ordered by the newest matching authorized message timestamp and message UUID. A conversation matching both appears once in the title tier. Reuse the authority-versioned title and message indexes under one scope snapshot. Deduplicate token expansions across both sources and sum their posting bounds and row work under the existing shared budgets. Field filters restrict this same matching and delivery path.
conversation.additional_scopes: Per-parent Binds require a separately qualified title and message-corpus plan in that scope. Collection and parent plus collection require independent qualification where the kind supports membership.

search.qualification: For each ready authority-versioned Bind, qualify its supported literal-term and prefix modes for windows up to query.window.max_request_span starting at offsets through qualified_depth. Serve later windows while both query.live_limits budgets for scoped postings and materialized rows hold. Use only the kind’s authorized scopes, order and scope-local statistics. Refuse unqualified shapes, scopes and sorts with unsupported_query_plan. End anchors are unavailable for search. The host returns WindowPlanError with reason end_unavailable and the renderer pages forward for End.
search.publication: The host owns the qualified list and search projections of item text and declared indexed fields. Apply query.list_publication to list projections. The existing background search worker publishes the search projections and same-generation term statistics independently of save acknowledgement. Check live access to the scope, searchable fields and output fields before evaluation. Readiness and invalidation compare revisions of the viewer’s authorized row-and-field projection, never a space-wide watermark. While that projection is behind or stale after revocation, return loading with no rows, count or activation contexts. A hidden-only edit leaves the visible search state, result version, rows, ranks and counts unchanged during and after publication. Fence cached results on revocation and recheck authority on delivery. Deny access if the scope is no longer authorized.
search.refinement: Bound scoped posting work using same-generation term frequencies. When an otherwise qualified query exhausts the scoped-posting or materialized-row budget, return refine_query with only bounded provisional rows from the same authorized query and published generation. A prefix exceeding either the expansion cap or the posting budget returns refine_query without starting expansion and can include only already-issued rows for that query, audience and generation. Omit count, activation contexts and member cache record. Provisional replies have null result_version and window_ref.
search.count: Non-search lists use maintained per-scope counts. Claimed-text exact search counts measure qualified matches in a ready authorized projection under the separate count-work and rate budgets and require exact-count authority. Search defaults to count mode none. Search estimates and exact distinct-thread search counts are unqualified. Refuse an unqualified count request with unsupported_query_plan. Apply current source authority before matching, ranking or counting. A title-only grant contributes only the authorized title corpus. Any body excerpt in a search row is independently checked.
search.field_filter: Optional on the Bind. Default all. Claimed-text kinds allow all, title or body. Conversation kinds allow all, title or messages. The request match shape is independent of the field filter and defaults to literal AND terms. A prefix is explicitly requested as one token prefix.
search.settle_generation: Required on search requests and all window deliveries (including refusals), absent on other Binds. Compare the lease, Bind and current renderer generation before applying any acknowledgement or window.

extractors.provenance: Every selector reads the same checked claimed-text item and produces a body-derived field. Expose the value and any filtered count only under the intersection of source and field audiences. No selector can mint an opaque host ref.

merge.TextSet: Union all grammar-normalized selector values. Use the output's common inline hierarchy separator to expand parents for all values, including frontmatter. Deduplicate exact normalized entries, including parents, and order deterministically. If there is no inline separator, use a flat union. Apply element, set and index-work caps to the resulting set before publishing it.
merge.other_fields: Allow one selector per output. Multiple inline selectors on the same TextSet output require the same separator.

extractors.initialization: Use the same extractors at create and save. A configured TextSet with no entries projects [] when authorized and requested. Omit absent scalar outputs from both the index and row fields. Text that extracts to no characters, including first_blocks and body_excerpt after normalization, is absent. A missing frontmatter scalar is absent. A valid Boolean false or Number zero is present. Never substitute null or an empty string for an absent scalar. A new device image slot has no ref.

Timestamp.description: The host emits RFC 3339 timestamps with seconds 00 to 59 only, recording a leap-second instant as second 59 with the fraction clamped to the maximum representable value.

CollectionRef.description: Opaque host-authorized CollectionRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

ExecutionRef.description: Opaque host-authorized ExecutionRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

RequestRef.description: Opaque host-authorized RequestRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

AccountRef.description: Opaque host-authorized AccountRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

AttachmentRef.description: Opaque host-authorized AttachmentRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

StatusRef.description: Opaque host-authorized StatusRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

UndoRef.description: Opaque host-authorized UndoRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

TrashSelectionRef.description: Opaque host-authorized TrashSelectionRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

DestinationFrameRef.description: Opaque host-authorized DestinationFrameRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

RevisionRef.description: Opaque host-authorized RevisionRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

QuoteRef.description: Opaque host-authorized QuoteRef reference. A compatible string shape does not grant authority.

ItemRef.description: Typed host reference for the declared kind and target. A scoped row may carry it; client markup cannot create it.

rows.description: Stable row IDs from the context-bound Bind for a bulk activation.

dispatch.description: Resolve and dispatch in one exchange only for an eligible catalogue operation with effective confirm:none. Otherwise return a resolution without running the operation.

final_text.description: Message content for a host-issued prepared Send only. The host returns ActionOutcome after committing the message/intent or forwarding checked steer. Retry with the same activation ID and final text. Any parser-derived change to recipients, routing, permissions or other prepared material requires a fresh resolve and preview.

confirm.description: Omitted for the ordinary separate resolve/dispatch path without an extra challenge. None permits the catalogue shortcut only. Challenge requires protected confirmation.

fields.description: Values match the resolved Bind projection and declared field types. Arrays are allowed only for a projected TextSet. Apply window_field_delivery and the live field and source checks before projecting each value. Omit absent extractor scalars. Field use as a live title, secondary part, search excerpt, mark or image fallback retains the original field audience and source authority. Body-derived fields need current body access.

parent_refs.description: Host-issued parent row reference for each authorized child Bind reached through a declared edge. Omit when the row has no eligible edge.

stale_images.description: Field names of retained older assets actually projected on this row. They remain fetchable under live authority and retention checks. Omit on persistence.

image_attribution.description: Optional uploader attribution by projected RowImageRef field. The host stamps it from the exact asset after checking the live viewer may see the uploader's identity. Only on ready member rows. Omit from cached records and refine replies.

offset.description: Actual offset of the delivered range from the reply anchor. Start is measured at its first returned row; end is the distance of the nearest returned row to the end. The rows are always in normal Bind order. Omit offset for an End loading reply. Otherwise, if no rows are returned, use the requested from. The host checks this equality against the originating request before issuing the reply.

rows.description: Opaque stable row IDs; no position is an authority reference.

count.description: Present only for an authorized ready or empty result. On empty, a supplied count is exact zero. On ready with an exact count, the host checks the returned range against that count before delivery, from either anchor. If rows are returned, offset plus their number is at most the count. A zero-row ready reply starts at or beyond the count.

state.description: refine_query asks the viewer to narrow a qualified search that exceeded a posting, row work or prefix expansion limit in query.search. Its rows are provisional and display only. On `refine_query`, stop any pending End or forward-paging navigation, keep the rows already shown, and show the refine message. Do not retry the same window. For a nonempty result set, forward paging ends on a short `ready` window, including a zero-row `ready` window at a page boundary. Keep the rows already shown. Only `state: "empty"` shows the Bind’s empty message. It means the whole result set is empty and is valid only when the requested `from` is zero.

activation_contexts.description: Present only for an authorized ready or empty result.

WindowResult.description: An authenticated reply for the active view and its audience. At from zero, the host sends empty for a wholly empty result. A ready reply at offset zero contains rows. Check the session, lease partition and audience before consuming rows or a cache record. Any cache record must match this view and window. Only a non-search Bind in a view with exact count authority receives an end anchor. A ready or empty End result carries count.mode exact and offset. During catch-up return loading on the exact active End request with anchor:end and the same Bind and parent scope. Omit both offset and count. Check count policy for the active Bind and scope on each delivery. An absolute offset above max_offset is only returned to a contiguous forward continuation without exact count authority, with anchor:start and no count or persistent cache record. Bind states have no route-dependent action context.

ProviderId.description: Installed provider contribution ID, unique across the installation. Refuse duplicate IDs at install, across packages and with bundled contributions. Before profile lookup pin the resolved package, manifest and adapter digests. Use only a profile bound to that contribution. Provider IDs remain open.

RowImagePublishResult.description: Publication reports the checked revision and opaque receipt. The host stores authenticated uploader provenance with the asset.

ExecutionChildRequestRef.description: Host-issued checked child request for the owning job, current parent attempt, authorized target and immutable requested material.

ExecutionStart.description: Only the request ID. The host derives the intent from the authenticated job invocation.

TranscriptCursor.description: Opaque record-level cursor bound to the conversation and viewer.

text.description: Canonical transcript record text. Use the host’s restricted Markdown renderer or show it as plain text. Embedded HTML is text.

attachments.description: Authorized attachments of this record in committed order. Omit inaccessible entries, and omit the field when none remain. Count toward the page or update byte cap.

SelectionRef.description: Host-issued reference to an eligible selection of at most 50 stable row IDs in this activation context.

rows.description: Stable rows in the checked Bind window set. An empty array clears the selection.

sentAt.description: Optional renderer telemetry. Never used for authorization, ordering or expiry.

parent.description: Required for a per-parent Bind only. Use the checked parent of the current scope.

settle_generation.description: Required for a search Bind only. Match the currently accepted search scope.

parent.description: Required for a per-parent Bind only. Use the checked parent of the current scope.

settle_generation.description: Required for a search Bind only. Match the currently accepted search scope.

ComposerOptionRef.description: Host-issued choice bound to viewer, thread and the needed option-source versions.

ActionContexts.description: Each composer context belongs only to its one action ID and component, including across view actions and embedded window row actions. The same token cannot also appear as an authored, shell or row action context.

lease.description: Starts the shared lease for current view, windows and authorized activation contexts.

activation_contexts.description: A host-issued action ID is the key. Resolve composer IDs through composer_actions[component_id] and use only that action ID’s exact issued context.

composer_actions.description: Complete per-component Send, Stop and Resume ID map. Omission means empty. Every listed ID has its exact context in activation_contexts in the same reply.

result_versions.description: Exact result versions keyed by current host-issued window_ref, including parent-specific windows.

renewal_id.description: Renderer-generated identifier unique to this renewal attempt. A newer attempt supersedes it.

LeaseRenewRequest.description: Renew the active lease using the lease ref, cache partition and grant revision from the last accepted open or renewal reply. The code path is the same on every renewal.

composer_actions.description: Complete per-component Send, Stop and Resume ID map. Omission means empty. Every listed ID has its exact context in activation_contexts in the same reply.

LeaseRenewResult.description: Accept only an authenticated host reply matching the outstanding renewal_id, current request_lease_ref and cache_partition. Retain only exact window_ref and result_version pairs authorized and previously issued to that lease. Ignore superseded replies and keep live rows hidden on timeout or refusal. At each renewal use the lease and grant from the latest accepted reply. Replace the composer ID map and contexts together, including on subsequent renewals and when a map is omitted. A changed lease or grant needs fresh composer contexts. A composer context is immutable for its exact component, purpose and action ID within the issued lease and grant. Reuse is allowed only for the same binding.

notify_creator.description: Enables host-generated notifications only. Use the checked enrollment label, outcome status and an authorized link. No fields, result text or snippets are accepted as notification sources. Recheck recipient and link authority at delivery.

ChoiceRef.description: Host-issued choice bound to one eligible row, option Bind result, owning prompt slot, viewer and activation context.

ChoiceOptionsRequest.description: Fetch scoped options before displaying the prompt. The host reconstructs the option Bind from the activation context and slot. Show the returned labels, then submit only the picked ref under that slot in interaction.choices.

parent.description: Required for source.parent:true and absent at the root. Use the ref issued for this child Bind in the actual parent row.

WindowRequestPayload.description: Request half-open [from,to) from the chosen anchor. The semantic loader requires from < to and a span within query.window.max_request_span for either anchor. Check authorized scope before using its count or index and return rows in normal Bind order. An end anchor requires a non-search Bind and an effective authorized count mode of exact. Refuse before computing or returning any end distance. Absolute jumps remain capped by query.window.max_offset, including explicit start anchors. Above the cap, an explicit start anchor is accepted only for a contiguous forward continuation without exact count authority at a checked, current ready window boundary.

CachePartitionRef.description: Opaque host partition identifier bound to the account, session, space, audience and view. It grants no authority.

parent.description: Required for a per-parent Bind only. Use the checked parent of the current scope.

settle_generation.description: Required for a search Bind only. Match the currently accepted search scope.

SelectionContextResult.description: Host issues selection contexts for exactly the stable row reported as drawn. Renderer waits if none matches that row and ignores unrelated or superseded contexts.

LayoutEntryRef.description: Host-issued ref for a section or placement in the current actor’s personal layout.

LayoutSectionRef.description: Host-issued ref for a section in the current actor’s personal layout.

sentAt.description: Optional telemetry. Never used for authorization or ordering.

parent.description: Required for a per-parent Bind only. Use the checked parent of the current scope.

settle_generation.description: Required for a search Bind only. Match the currently accepted search scope.

SettledSelectionRequest.description: Settled single selection in the current authorized view. The host validates the drawn row under the Bind and returns its SelectionContextResult.

WindowParentRef.description: Host-issued row reference bound to the declared parent edge, child Bind, full parent ancestry and current authorized view and audience. Validate every request, including counts. Invalid, foreign or stale references confer no scope.

RowActionTarget.description: Available only inside a Bind row template. Use item for the row item and placement for a Section.repeat row’s LayoutEntryRef. No view or Bind state can supply these targets.

subtitle.description: Host-allowlisted offline text only. Dates use subtitle_timestamp. The host checks source provenance and excludes every body-derived part before signing.

subtitle_timestamp.description: Authorized timestamp of the first declared date part, if approved for offline display. Use the format of that part from the pinned row template on the device. For Notes this is the date from its secondary line.

proof.description: Proof wire form ed25519.<key_id>.<base64url signature>, over the domain string calternal-member-row-cache-v2 followed by LF and RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this record without proof.

MemberRowCacheRecord.description: The only persistable viewer projection. Issue only on an opted-in, ready or empty start-anchored root window for a live own-space member whose Bind has invariant query inputs. A list may name a literal collection. No reference, search text, route, form, selection or parent operand in its source, filter or sort. Authenticate the account, space, template, Bind, window and offset. The host builds the display record from the authoritative title and host-allowlisted non-body display fields approved for offline use. Exclude body excerpts and any field marked body_derived from every display part, regardless of its template position. Omit the record if any required title is ineligible. Body-derived parts appear only from a fresh authorized window. Never include row IDs, contexts, action material or credentials.

reason.description: skip_limit means an otherwise qualified index-only jump would skip too many entries. end_unavailable means the requested end anchor targets a search Bind or the effective count mode is estimate or none. unsupported_plan means no qualified plan for the scope, filters, sort, search or count. materialization_limit means a qualified non-search plan would materialize too many rows. Search row-budget exhaustion returns refine_query. After skip_limit the renderer pages from the nearer permitted end (start for search Binds or when the view lacks exact-count authority), keeping the original jump target as its goal. After end_unavailable it pages forward from the last loaded row. For a nonempty result set, forward paging ends on a short `ready` window, including a zero-row `ready` window at a page boundary. Keep the rows already shown. Only `state: "empty"` shows the Bind’s empty message. It means the whole result set is empty and is valid only when the requested `from` is zero. On `refine_query`, stop any pending End or forward-paging navigation, keep the rows already shown, and show the refine message. Do not retry the same window. Every other reason shows the Bind error state.

settle_generation.description: Echo for a search Bind refusal so the renderer can discard a superseded generation.

WindowPlanError.description: Typed response to the corresponding window request when no qualified bounded plan is available.

NoNetworkBadgeManifest.description: Install and gallery badge and filter predicate for an already validated manifest. Worker egress denial separately follows network:none.

WindowAudience.description: Host-asserted audience of the authenticated active view. member denotes other member views. Compare with the active view before accepting any window.

WindowAnchor.description: start counts from the first row; end counts backward from the last authorized row, with zero at the last row. The end anchor is available only for a non-search Bind whose effective authorized count mode is exact.

SearchMatchShape.description: Terms combines compiled literal tokens with AND within query.search.max_literal_and_terms. Prefix explicitly requests one literal token prefix within query.search.max_token_prefix_expansions. Punctuation never chooses the match shape. Raw Boolean, phrase and fuzzy syntax and mixtures of terms and prefixes are unqualified. The active search uses this input independently of the Bind field filter.

RowImageRef.description: Host-issued opaque display reference carried in a projected field. It has no sort or filter operators and cannot supply an operation operand. Read through query.row_images.

fallback.description: Projected body_excerpt Text field. Draw a simple document miniature from the freshly authorized snippet when the image is missing or loading. When no snippet is available, draw the document miniature without text.

aspect.description: Portrait leading image for this row.

RowImageIcon.description: The description names a projected field of type RowImageRef. The renderer reads it as specified by query.row_images. Use the optional fallback according to query.row_images.

SearchWindowRequest.description: The shared window envelope validated after resolving its Bind as a search. A missing anchor defaults to start. Refuse an end anchor with end_unavailable.

RouteOperands.description: Each request can carry at most eight distinct declared inputs. At install check each Bind source plus both filter groups, and that same union plus each row action’s route inputs, including an optional input when its offered behavior depends on it. For view open combine the required root component operands with each chrome or content action or component’s inputs. Count duplicated names once. Unrelated consumers may use separate requests.

material.description: Checked effect and input details. Apply confirmation.material_by_kind.host.approval.resolve.request_card. Decisions and lifetimes come exclusively from actions.

parent.description: Required for a per-parent Bind only. Use the checked parent of the current scope.
Required for a per-parent Bind only. Use the checked parent of the current scope.

ExecutionIntentRef.description: Opaque exact durable execution intent under execution_intents. Valid only in its owning job context or host-issued execution control.

TranscriptBodyRef.description: Opaque continuation token bound to viewer, view lease, conversation, exact record revision and next UTF-8 offset.

CommittedTranscriptCursor.description: Null until the first canonical record exists. Omit after/before when reading or following an empty transcript.

SearchSettleGeneration.description: Renderer sequence per lease and resolved search Bind. A lower generation never supersedes a higher one. Reuse a generation only for exact replay.

HostWorkerInvokeFrame.description: Host-to-worker only. The trusted host stamps job_context on claims and replays of a manifest job with execution_intent:true. For every other invocation omit it. It is separate from operation input and conveys no new authority.

ExecutionAttemptChildRequest.description: Authenticated attempt channel only. Resolve the parent attempt and actor from the channel. Accept a bounded target conversation kind and only host-issued refs within current parent and ancestor ceilings.

ExecutionAttemptChildRefusal.description: pending_limit means the authenticated parent cannot reserve a new slot. Use unavailable for a stale fence, unavailable target or retired request. request_mismatch means changed input under the same live receipt.

TranscriptAttachmentRef.description: Opaque view-bound reference to the checked attachment of an exact committed transcript record.

ResumeResolution.description: A protected challenge. Apply confirmation.material_by_kind for host.execution.resume.

execution_start.scope: Apply execution_intents.admission. Derive the intent and owning job receipt from authenticated job context at claim and replay. Under the lifecycle fence recheck that binding, live item state, pinned contribution and placement. An authorized replay returns the existing result even with a new request ID. Refuse missing, foreign or retired context.

execution_status.scope: Eligible live execution actor and current attempt.

execution_input.scope: Exact attempt and live steer authority. Prepared active Send may forward directly.

execution_spawn_child.scope: Only the owning job consumes a live checked request. Resolve pinned kind and refs, and recheck exact parent, live caller, eligible target, all ancestor ceilings and reserved tree capacity. Convert the reserved slot to admitted execution with child item and parent edge under one fence. A retryable refusal keeps the unexpired reservation. A terminal refusal releases it exactly once. Durable receipt replay adds no child or slot.

execution_wait.scope: Owning job. Compare durable cursor and deliver or park atomically. No token wakes.

display_frame.scope: Authenticated attempt transport. Host validates, scrubs and maintains canonical records under execution_attempt_authority.discovery.transcript_audience. This format is not a renderer route.

child_request.scope: Check exact current parent, live actor, eligible target, refs and ancestor ceilings under the tree reservation fence. Resolve an existing parent-attempt receipt first. Exact live replay returns the same ref without another transition or reservation. Reject changed input or retired requests. For a fresh receipt atomically reserve pending and aggregate tree capacity before storing the request and its child_requested transition. At capacity return pending_limit without a record, receipt, transition or wake. Release pending capacity once on consumption, expiry or fencing and retire the queued transition. Expiry and fencing survive restart. Recheck authority before returning the reply.

row_images.prepare.scope: Editor-scoped EventComponent after the save ACK. The request component matches the envelope and the current item-editor in edit mode. Check live editor lease, item, slot and exact source revision and digest before issuing the upload grant.

transcript.follow.scope: Same authenticated view subscription. Upsert committed records by record_id. Replace the single optional provisional preview on every update. Only the committed_cursor is resumable. Cancel on route, lease or audience change. Recheck live corpus and each attachment grant at read and egress. An inaccessible attachment has no returned ref, media type, size or placeholder. Replace the entire attachment projection on an upsert. If an attachment grant changes, fence affected cached deliveries and refresh the affected record for a still-authorized viewer before drawing it again.

transcript.page.scope: An authorized conversation and viewer. No cursor selects the newest page. before pages older and after resumes, refreshing the boundary record and notices. Records are ordered oldest to newest. Recheck live corpus and each attachment grant at read and egress. An inaccessible attachment has no returned ref, media type, size or placeholder.

sealed_frame.open.scope: Authorized committed revision and current audience

sealed_frame.resize.scope: Trusted wrapper for the current frame

sealed_frame.open_link.scope: Host link ID from the current frame, with fresh route authorization

selection.set.scope: Current authorized Bind and lease, for a checked set of selected rows or a clear. Validate the exact parent for a per-parent Bind and the exact current generation and scope for a search Bind. Bind issued contexts and set refs to that scope.

composer.options.scope: Checked conversation ItemRef, viewer and installed provider/runtime option source Resolve provider, model for that provider, then reasoning using both. Permission and machine are independent requests with preceding choices supplied for eligibility checks. Changing an upstream option invalidates dependent refs and pages.

undo.scope: Host surface and current actor/target authority

status.scope: Host surface and current actor/target authority

request_resolve.scope: Check the exact request, live actor, context, selected offered lifetime and current approvability. A one-use approval must gate the exact checked effect at tool dispatch. A repeated answer cannot dispatch again.

share_sheet.scope: Host surface and current actor/target authority

trash_sheet.scope: Host surface and current actor/target authority

view.open.scope: Authenticated view session, including data-free render and its sources. Composer Send, Stop and Resume resolve through composer_actions[component_id] and activation_contexts[action_id] from this view. Guest and public receive no viewer or account identity. Resolve declared route consumers from all chrome and content, including sidebar shortcuts and section actions and footer actions. Missing optional host.item.create collection operands mean no placement.

view.renew.scope: Original authenticated view session and cache partition, with fresh authority for the requested lease and its issued window versions Replace the composer action map and its contexts together after accepting the correlated renewal. Recompute eligibility and retire omitted IDs or replaced contexts. A newly eligible Stop may target any unresolved execution intent. Recompute Resume eligibility and require a fresh context if the binding or material changes.

choice.options.scope: Context-bound prompt and authorized option Bind; never accepts a raw client target

selection.settled.scope: Current authorized Bind and lease. Reconstruct the exact stable row named by the settled selection before issuing contexts. Validate the exact parent for a per-parent Bind and the exact current generation and scope for a search Bind. Bind issued contexts and set refs to that scope.

transcript.quote.scope: For one authorized committed record, verify ordered range on UTF-8 character boundaries and bound excerpt bytes. Bind the token to actor, conversation and the pinned record.

request-card.read.scope: Current member lease, declared component, exact reconstructed request and designated actor. Recheck authority before rendering and resolution. Reply with opaque not-found on any mismatch. Every native provider request must permit approval and the gateway must be able to enforce its exact effect inside the attempt sandbox before offering Approve. Otherwise offer dismissal only.

editor.open.scope: Current view lease and exact checked item bound to the declared editor component. Returns only the authorized committed head pinned for the range route. A conversation body additionally requires corpus authority. Conversation editing uses the canonical conversation engine only.

search.settled.scope: Check the lease, Bind, required route operands and WindowParentRef before acknowledging. Require parent iff the Bind declares source.parent. Pin the generation to the exact resolved collection, parent and ancestry where declared, along with the full predicate, authorized audience, text and match. Echo the checked parent and generation. An exact current replay is idempotent. Fence older generations and reject changed input or scope on same-generation replay. Every window, settled selection and explicit selection set must resolve to the pinned scope. A changed collection, parent or route requires a new generation starting at zero. An invalid parent gets the same opaque refusal as an absent scope. For a valid scope lacking the qualified index, the first window returns unsupported_plan without scanning candidates.

transcript.body.scope: Return the next whole UTF-8 segment of that pinned record only. Check live viewer, lease, corpus, exact record and offset at read and egress. Absent, expired, purged or unauthorized refs return opaque 404 without bytes or a continuation. A final page omits next.

transcript.attachment.response: Authenticated binary download of exactly the projected bytes with the checked Content-Type, Content-Length and Content-Disposition: attachment. Enforce nosniff and no-store. No inline HTML, redirects, public URLs, conditional or range responses.
transcript.attachment.scope: Same conversation-transcript component and active view lease. Resolve the opaque ref to the exact conversation, record and immutable attachment revision. Check live corpus, attachment grant and retained bytes at read and egress, and fence a revoked stream. An absent, mismatched, expired, purged or unauthorized ref returns opaque 404 before any metadata or bytes are sent.

conversation_capability.declaration: An installed package kind opts in with conversation: true. Only eligible package and viewer access qualify. The kind owner declares corpus and Send policy.

provider_icon.description: Host-projected catalogue symbol for the installed provider contribution identified by the thread's provider. Emit it only after the provider_marks binding check. On a missing or conflicting binding, omit the field so the row template uses its generic fallback symbol.

waiting_on.description: From live checked Inbox requests addressed to the viewer. Another viewer’s requests change neither rows, count nor version.

snoozed_until.description: Actor-scoped active snooze deadline. Null once the deadline passes; host invalidates affected Bind results at expiry.

parent.description: Host-owned conversation parent relation. Check both items and the declared scoped parent seek.

active_execution.description: Nullable ref for an exact admitted attempt, only in a ready member reply to an eligible execution actor. The parent edge resolves to an ItemRef. Starting may have only an intent-based Stop context.

conversation_capability.body_authority: Only the canonical transcript engine writes the body. Refuse generic save and editor-room, staged and range mutations. Require message-corpus authority on raw body delivery including editor, range and history material for any pinned revision. Title-only grants confer no corpus access.

title.description: The kind’s ordinary Text metadata source with a canonical declaration under the manifest’s title_field rule. Install rejects a body-derived source, extractor output, host-owned projection and an indexed source whose declared audience is narrower than shared_projection. Use the same authorized source for list, shared title, title search and offline display.

confirmation.none: A host catalogue read, or a host catalogue mutation marked atomic_undo whose engine commits the complete effect and Undo in one recovery-visible transaction and satisfies any atomic_undo_when condition. For mutations the only material may be the drawn target or fields of the submitting form. host.item.create may also use its checked route or literal CollectionRef. For host.collection.move, the checked ChoiceRef and its actor-only destination may use the shortcut under confirmation_when.
confirmation.challenge: Irreversible, external, widens_access, bulk sets, declared material_inputs, any destination, recipient, audience or permission, or unproven material. Never bypassed by atomic_undo. Use the confirmation_when rules for host.item.create and host.collection.move.
confirmation.ordinary: Worker operations always use separate resolution and dispatch. A reversible manifest declaration never permits the shortcut. Return a challenge only for required material or effects; otherwise omit confirm.

request_card.rule: Show exactly the host's checked effect and its checked named inputs. Reject missing, duplicate, unchecked or altered display material. Derive decision and lifetime entries exclusively from offered actions. Reject their presence as material fields or duplicate offered decisions. A closed card supplies no decisions or lifetimes.

confirmation.material_rule: Select the row by the checked operation and host surface. Check all material for the exact normalized request under the pinned context. Reject empty lists, duplicate names or missing required entries. For every current checked fact listed in when, require its entries too. Include untouched prefills and all applicable material. Plugin challenges also include present manifest material_inputs as checked by the host. Host keys are host-owned. Every manifest input key is projected with manifest_input_prefix and its original local ID, using its declared label and checked value. The prefix is reserved and is unavailable to host entries. Render labels and checked values. Explicit default, none or clearing choices are shown with a readable label. The device cannot supply the challenge kind or facts.

cache_policy.persistent_row_scope: Start-anchored root list windows with invariant inputs only. Permit a literal collection and account-bound viewer:person. Deny search, references and route, form, selection or parent operands in source, filter or sort. Verify shape, host proof, account, space, template, Bind, offset, lifetime and opt-ins on write and load. On write the record must match the authenticated active view and reply, including own_space_member audience and window_ref. On load use only the matching local own-space root display. Never serialize a WindowResult.
cache_policy.persistent_row_authority: Display on unlocked devices as unconfirmed until the host confirms or corrects the rows. Encrypt with account- and space-bound keys. Never persist guest or public rows, action credentials or contexts. Erase on sign-out, account switch or known revocation. Every action requires a fresh host context.

execution_attempt_authority.principal: A distinct host-minted principal per exact attempt, bound to the sender and the admitted request. Its separately fenced lease grants no ordinary invocation ticket or member principal.
execution_attempt_authority.broker: Use purpose-specific operations on admitted host-issued refs within effect ceilings and the discovery grant below. Reject raw enumeration and bulk exports, foreign scopes, forged tickets, and job enqueue, ticket minting or delegation used to widen discovery.
execution_attempt_authority.renewal_and_egress: Recheck the exact attempt and runtime fence, the sender's live authority, grants, job or session, package generation and placement at renewal, effects and output egress. Revoke fences immediately and stops renewal.

discovery.grant: The sender's request to find items grants discovery within that space. No separate confirmation in either Full access or Approve for me. Existing controls still apply to any later effect.
discovery.authority: Apply the transcript audience rule before matching, ranking, counting or returning rows, fields and excerpts. Keep the existing query bounds and access records. Recheck live authority at planning and delivery. A child stays under every ancestor's ceiling.

transcript_audience.sender_only: Use the sender's full scoped live read rights.
transcript_audience.shared: Require the sender and every transcript reader to be authorized for each discovery input.
transcript_audience.in_flight: Fence pending derived output if the transcript audience widens or source grants cease to cover it. Suppress delivery and commit. Resume the work only in a fresh attempt that excludes the ineligible context.

provider_login.custody: The verified provider program can read and refresh its own selected login and directories in the person's eligible sandbox. Provider tools there run as that person and can read those files. These native logins require no broker. Keep the directories out of other accounts, other packages, shared mounts, host-readable output and portable snapshots and backups.
provider_login.shared_space: Apply owner decision 74 in docs/open-questions.md. Keep tools off for the configured shared login until qualification proves a boundary that protects it from tools and other runs. For a shared transcript, choosing a personal native login or changing permission mode cannot enable tools.

carrier.invoke_scope: The host dispatches to the exact admitted package, digest, epoch and ticket. For composer jobs admitted by Send or Resume, include on claim and replay the pinned ExecutionJobContext. For all other invocations omit it. Refuse a worker-origin invoke or any worker-supplied job context.

offline_member_display.scope: Check live own-space membership, the paired window and the host offline allowlist. Cache only a prefix of those rows in the same order. Take the title from the row title field. For the secondary line take only eligible plain text parts or the first eligible declared date part. Drop body-backed parts and restricted fields regardless of the display slot. Omit the record if any required title is ineligible. A provider label is ordinary eligible Text metadata from the paired row. The provider icon and provider authority are separate.

execution_intents.admission: Under the conversation lifecycle fence refuse admission for an archived or deleted head or a cutover-fenced writer. Reserve the same quotas for either origin. Allow at most one unresolved execution intent or active attempt per conversation. Commit Starting, the exact intent, its receipt and owning job together. Exact-intent start admits at most one attempt and an authorized replay returns its existing result.
execution_intents.stop_and_archive: Idle archive requires no unresolved intent, active attempt or approval to retire. Protected archive and Stop use attempt_authority_end, pin the exact attempt or intent and recheck live execution-control and item authority. Never retarget replacements.
execution_intents.snooze: Actor-keyed snooze and Undo only change the actor's deadline and its publication intent. Neither mutates, retires, reopens or admits any execution intent, nor changes retries.
execution_intents.cutover: Halt new intents and attempts. Drain every unresolved execution intent or verify its existing protected durable refusal and verify zero active attempts and zero unresolved execution intents before switching writers. Preserve intents, refusals and receipts under protected custody. Do not admit or reopen retired intents on the new writer or rollback.

attempt_authority_end.commit_rule: Make the local fence and the specific recovery work durable before reporting success or allowing any later admission, renewal, effect or egress. Invalidate queued dispatch and scoped references and fence descendants. Where authority spans databases, durably fence affected spaces before publishing the authority change and block work until reconciled. Keep the exact attempt identity, generation and cleanup key. Dispatch no remote work under the fence. Recover committed cleanup after crash before reply or dispatch. Deduplicate remote teardown by exact attempt, and release quota only after verifying it. Earlier committed effects stay committed.

archive.before_reply: Exact admitted attempt fence or durable pending-intent refusal, archived head, any eligible Undo and deduplicated cleanup record in the same FULL transaction. Undo leaves the fence and refusal in place.
archive.after_commit: Exact-attempt Stop and bounded subtree cleanup. Pending intent without an attempt needs no remote Stop.

stop.before_reply: Exact admitted attempt fence or durable pending-intent refusal, Stop receipt and deduplicated cleanup record under the same lifecycle commit.
stop.after_commit: Exact-attempt Stop and verified subtree cleanup.

snooze.before_reply: No execution fence. Actor-keyed snooze and Undo change only the personal deadline and its durable publication intent.
snooze.after_commit: None. Snooze does not dispatch Stop.

space_erasure.before_reply: Space admission tombstone and recovery-visible authority fence for every affected attempt, descendant and unresolved intent. Record cleanup before acknowledging erasure.
space_erasure.after_commit: Stop affected attempts and reclaim space data only after verified teardown.

account_erasure.before_reply: Account principal fence and a durable affected-space fence before publishing erasure. Retire that principal's attempts, descendants and pending intents. Hold affected spaces closed until reconciliation.
account_erasure.after_commit: Stop affected exact attempts and finish account cleanup after teardown.

membership_revocation.before_reply: Live membership generation and a durable affected-space fence for attempts, descendants and unresolved intents whose authority disappears.
membership_revocation.after_commit: Stop only attempts that lose their authority and reconcile scope cleanup.

grant_change.before_reply: Changed effective grant or profile generation and a durable fence for attempts, descendants and intents whose admitted authority no longer holds. A widening grants no additional attempt rights.
grant_change.after_commit: Stop affected exact attempts and reconcile the grant or credential references.

conversation_erasure.before_reply: Item deletion or purge fence, including affected admitted attempts, descendants and pending intents. Ordinary Trash of an active conversation requires the separately authorized Stop first.
conversation_erasure.after_commit: Stop any affected live attempt on the authorized erase path, then finish bounded purge.

session_or_job_retirement.before_reply: Invalidated session or scheduled principal, cancelled or replaced current job, and the corresponding attempt, descendant and intent fences.
session_or_job_retirement.after_commit: Stop the affected attempts and retire their queued work.

package_or_placement_retirement.before_reply: Invalidated package generation, enrollment, placement or runtime lease and durable fences for its affected attempts and intents.
package_or_placement_retirement.after_commit: Dispatch exact Stops where reachable and reconcile runtime teardown before releasing quota.

cutover_retirement.before_reply: Old-writer generation and new-admission fence. Switch only after zero active attempts and zero unresolved execution intents. Keep earlier authorized retirement fences and refusals through switch or rollback.
cutover_retirement.after_commit: Replay only outstanding cleanup for already retired attempts. Ordinary cutover issues no new Stop.

failed_reattachment.before_reply: Under the lifecycle fence durably retire the exact old attempt and its descendant authorities with the interrupted status, committed transcript boundary and deduplicated cleanup. Apply when same-execution proof, continuity, safe provider continuation or fresh renewal fails while the attempt may still exist. Refuse later renewals even when its placement lease is valid.
failed_reattachment.after_commit: Dispatch exact old-attempt Stop or reconcile verified death. Preserve published records and reconcile any uncertain provider effect before an authorized person can Resume with a fresh intent.

ancestor_authority_loss.before_reply: Persist the lost ancestor fence and its subtree admission and effect fence, including descendant attempts and checked child reservations, before completing the authority change.
ancestor_authority_loss.after_commit: Stop affected descendants by exact attempt and retire the affected child reservations after verification.

runtime_freeze.before_reply: Persist the attempt generation and arm the runtime's independent heartbeat and renewal deadlines before admission. At the earlier freeze cutoff the runtime closes its gateway, fences queued dispatch and freezes the full subtree, including during server loss. Freeze blocks effects and egress while hold and quota remain.
runtime_freeze.after_commit: Dispatch no Stop on a mere freeze. Thaw only after fresh same-execution proof and one-use renewal. Failed recovery or elapsed teardown deadline follows its own retirement row.

runtime_teardown_deadline.before_reply: The durably armed recovery deadline starts local teardown independently of the host. On observation persist irreversible retirement for that exact attempt and its subtree. No thaw once teardown starts. Keep quota while death or gateway closure is unverified.
runtime_teardown_deadline.after_commit: Reconcile runtime-local kill and verify subtree and gateway teardown. Reclaim quota and retire the private spool only under its recovery policy. No new remote Stop is needed for the runtime-owned teardown.

attempt_terminal.before_reply: Persist the exact attempt's terminal or interrupted state, fence its scoped work and descendants, and record cleanup and spool retirement. This includes provider terminal output and the sealed live-link drain-stall interruption.
attempt_terminal.after_commit: Verify teardown of remaining workers, tools and gateway, stopping the exact attempt if needed. Preserve the committed transcript boundary and uncertain-effect reconciliation.
